notes.title: Added Language Support
notes.content:
I have officially added five additional languages to the game! Unfoutunelty, I could not include two of the languages I had previously said I would do to translation issues, however, I did include one extra one.

The Languages add are Spanish, Russian, French, German, and Portuguese.

I hope this update will make it easier for people of other cultures to play the game!

Other additions:

[list]
[*] Added an instructions button to the pause menu. This will allow you to look over what you are supposed to do to scare away the monsters.
[*] 
[*] Added subtitles. This will make it easier to understand what is being said during the phone calls.
[*] 
[*] Fixed saving bug. There was a bug that would cause the game to not save if it was closed using the X button at the top of the window. It will no longer do that.
[*] 
[*] Minor tweaks to monster aggressiveness.
[*] 
[*] Mike's phone calls can now be skipped immediately. Some people were annoyed that they had to listen to the beginning of Mikes's phone calls every time they had to restart a level. (I understand! I had to listen to them for HOURS trying to get them to work right.) You now skip it right away.
[/list]
